_: ⭐⭐ THE FOUR PROBES AS SAVED TRADINGVIEW SCRIPTS. Read ids from HERE, not from a prose table.
_why: Once a probe is a saved script it is addressable by id, so a capture visit is createStudy-by-id with no Pine editor, no paste, and no binding hazard at all. This file is the id map that makes that possible.
_scope: ⛔ scriptId is ACCOUNT-scoped and stable across layouts. onChartSourceId_this_layout_only is NOT — it is a per-layout handle for the disposable layout below and is worthless anywhere else. Never key anything durable on it.

sessionClock._: ⚠️ THE SAVE/ADD RUN FINISHED AFTER THE CLOSE. Every probe here is saved and on the chart, but any capture whose meaning depends on an OPEN session — the D-realtime run, and tuple N23 (HTF_minus_close, 0 means still running) — was outside the window and must be re-read during RTH. ⭐ Recorded as an instant rather than a verdict: barstate-full read isrealtime=1 and isconfirmed=0 on the newest daily bar at 16:17:58 ET, i.e. the daily bar was still unconfirmed 18 minutes after the close, which is itself the answer to when the tri-state flips and is NOT the same as 'the market is open'.

how: Per probe: script-title dropdown -> Create new -> Indicator (the unbind; yields a fresh Monaco model whose action button reads 'Add to chart'), then the committed bytes were written straight into the model via the Monaco editor API and sha256-verified IN THE EDITOR against the committed file before anything was clicked, then Save script (the name is pre-filled from the indicator() declaration, so nothing was typed), then Add to chart.

gates.bytes: sha256 of the editor's own getValue() == sha256 of the committed file, checked before Save.
gates.roster: vendor _metaInfo.plots order == the committed source's plot() order, derived by a balanced-paren scan. ⛔ NEVER a regex: plot(str.contains(a, b) ? 1 : 0, "name") has commas inside its first argument and the obvious pattern silently drops it, returning 11 names for a 12-plot file.
gates.compiled: ⛔⛔ isFailed === false AND plot count == the committed source's. A study that fails to compile keeps a ONE-PLOT STUB _metaInfo titled "Plot" with the shared placeholder digest 0366beecad3fa344b185adf5e6ac9b35f5419485 and an EMPTY _data._items. Read a roster off that stub and you will record a 1-plot study that never ran as though it answered.
gates.identity: scriptId must not be 787899e2… — that is TradingView's shared UNSAVED-BUFFER slot, not a saved script (pine-facade GET on it returns 404 against 200s for real ids). The assertion means 'genuinely saved', not 'not the owner's'.

ownerScriptsUntouched._: ⭐ H1 evidence, read from the account's own saved list AFTER the run, not inferred.

Corrected in place 20:42:17Z to `syminfo.prefix`, with N11 deleted as vacuous. SAME script id: this is a new version of one script, not a second script.

vendorStorageNormalisation._: ⭐⭐ WHAT TRADINGVIEW STORES IS NOT BYTE-EQUAL TO THE COMMITTED FILE, AND THAT IS EXPECTED. Measured 2026-09-10 by reading each saved script back from pine-facade and hashing it.
vendorStorageNormalisation.rule:
stored == committed.replace('
', '
')  — a pure LF->CRLF normalisation. Content identical; no character of the source is altered, added or removed.
vendorStorageNormalisation.howToCompare:
⛔ A NAIVE sha256(committed) == sha256(stored) COMPARISON FAILS ON ALL FOUR AND MEANS NOTHING. Normalise first, and allow the trailing newline to be absent: stored == committed.replace('
','
') OR stored == committed.rstrip('
').replace('
','
'). Anything else is real content drift and the capture must be refused.
vendorStorageNormalisation.deltasObserved: +13 / +125 / +31 / +139 chars — NOT a constant, which is why this looked at first like an injected header. It is (number of line breaks) minus (1 if the trailing newline was dropped).
vendorStorageNormalisation.trailingNewline: ⚠️ UCTPROBE_FOLD is stored WITHOUT its trailing newline; the other three keep it. That is not a vendor behaviour — it is the earlier injection procedure, which measured and wrote the source with the trailing LF stripped (the 628-char and 8791-char figures in the superseded notes are exactly charsNoTrailingLF). Today's three wrote the file whole. Semantically nil for Pine: same roster, same values, same compile. Left as-is rather than re-saving, because re-saving means binding the editor to a saved script and the gain is a trailing newline.

_saveGotcha_2026_09_10: ⚠️ THE TOOLBAR 'Save script' ICON DID NOT SAVE; THE DROPDOWN MENU ITEM DID. Two clicks at the icon's measured position (title="Save script") left the vendor's stored source and `updated` timestamp untouched -- verified on a no-store fetch against TWO endpoints, 35 minutes after the original save. The same action from the script-title dropdown saved within 500ms. ⛔ The cause was NOT isolated (a plausible candidate is that `model.setValue()` leaves the toolbar's handler unarmed until the editor is otherwise interacted with), so this is recorded as OBSERVED, not explained. ⭐ THE LESSON IS THE VERIFICATION, NOT THE BUTTON: a save is confirmed by re-reading the stored source and its `updated` stamp from pine-facade, never by the click returning cleanly or by the status line. Both clicks looked exactly like success.
